items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: he made Luis Russell the leader of the band. So we're working for Russell now.

ctx.x: And you must have heard Simeon?

Oh, I knew Simeon, sure. I knew Simeon well. In fact, when Simeon come here, he...Russell sent for him to take my place at the Nest Club. I was in the band, and Simeon come in... Because I was... Where was I going then? I left Russell so many times. I don't know where I was going then. And when I was leaving him, he got Simeon to come. And I don't know if that's when I was going to work with Willie Lynch or not -- Willie's band, you know. That's when I met Simeon, down at the Nest Club. Yeah, he'd taken my place.…
After your initial enthusiasm at the Savoy, and meeting Chick Webb and all these people, did you go back to Boston?
